## Problem

Every COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar is emitted with `material=None` — `completion_sidecar.emit(result, material=None, repo_root=repo_root)` at `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py:405`, with the comment at `:754` noting no fingerprint is computed on this path. Measured on the live store: 0 of the most recent 300 COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecars (216 PASS / 59 FAIL / 23 no-verdict / 2 ERROR) carry any material/material_fingerprint field.

## Consequence (why this is worth fixing)

A FAIL followed by a PASS on the same `verified_at_sha` cannot be attributed: verifier inputs include ticket comments and prefetched evidence, which change without a code commit, so "no commit in between" does not mean "same inputs." This makes the completion gate's precision unmeasurable from its own records (an analysis this week mis-derived an "80–84% FP" figure from exactly this gap), and it means completion attestations cannot support the stale-material currency discipline that plan-review attestations already have.

Note: the `material=None` is deliberate per the code's own comment — this ticket treats the capability gap as the defect (operator-directed filing, 2026-08-31). Formula/prompt version stamping in the same record would make longitudinal gate analysis version-aware (pass-3 blocking formulas have changed over time, so unversioned sidecars conflate formula eras).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecars (PASS, FAIL, ERROR alike) record a material fingerprint over the verifier's actual inputs (ticket material as pinned for the run: description/ACs/comments snapshot + evidence set identifiers), reusing the existing plan-review fingerprint machinery where applicable rather than inventing a new scheme.
- [ ] Sidecars record the verifier formula/prompt version identifier alongside the fingerprint.
- [ ] Existing sidecars are untouched (no backfill); consumers treat absent material as "unknown era".
- [ ] A regression test asserts a FAIL sidecar carries a non-null fingerprint and version.

## File impact

To be confirmed at investigation (bugs do not pre-declare impact): expected `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py`, `src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py` (or equivalent emitter), one test module.

## Fix plan (2026-08-31, revised after plan-review feedback)

### Root cause

The completion verifier already computes or can compute input identity before close publication, but close-time and standalone sidecar emitters pass `material=None`, and `completion_sidecar.build_payload` serializes only that explicit argument. Atomic PASS calls `build_payload` directly. Completion ERROR records in the same `COMPLETION_VERDICT` stream also lack a version/fingerprint stamp. The fix is additive record enrichment only: verdicts, close blocking, signing eligibility, and best-effort swallow behavior do not change.

### Fingerprint contract and examples

New sidecars keep the existing field name `material_fingerprint`, but the value is a sha256-16 over a JSON object with schema `completion_verifier_material_v1`.

Normal pinned PASS/FAIL example:

```
material_basis = "pinned_completion_inputs"
fingerprint basis = {
  "schema": "completion_verifier_material_v1",
  "material_basis": "pinned_completion_inputs",
  "plan_material_fingerprint": "<current_material_fingerprint from pass1/material_diff>",
  "completion_read_basis": {
    "code_oid": "<verified_at_sha>",
    "tickets_oid": "<pinned tickets OID>",
    "receipt_digest": "<ticket_view receipt digest>",
    "run_id": "<pinned view run id>"
  },
  "completion_prefetch_manifest": [{"path": "src/x.py", "mode": "full"}]
}
```

The `receipt_digest` is mandatory for the normal pinned close path because it covers the ticket state/comments snapshot actually consulted. The prefetch manifest identifiers are threaded from precheck to reconcile so the evidence set named in the prompt participates too.

Defined fallback values:

- `material_basis="unpinned_completion_inputs"`: a legacy/local/deterministic precheck FAIL has no `completion_read_basis`, but a current ticket material fingerprint is available. The hash includes the plan material and this marker, so it is non-null but not comparable to the pinned composite.
- `material_basis="error_unpinned"`: a completion `gate_error_v1` ERROR occurs before a normal verifier result exists. The hash includes current ticket material plus this marker. It is explicitly not comparable to pinned PASS/FAIL records.
- If no ticket material can be read at all, material remains absent/unknown; the emit still swallows the observability failure and does not change the gate outcome.

### Version contract

Each new completion sidecar carries a nested `verifier_version` object:

```
{
  "prompt_id": "completion-verifier",
  "prompt_content_sha256": "<git-canonical prompt body hash>",
  "formula_version": "<signing.gate_code_version()>"
}
```

This uses existing prompt-library and gate-code-version machinery (parallel to plan-review's version stamps) rather than a new registry. Old records without this object remain unknown-era records.

### Shared ERROR sidecar scope

`gate_error_sidecar` is shared by `plan_review`, `code_review`, and `completion`. The change will be gated on `gate == "completion"` only; plan-review and code-review ERROR payloads remain byte-shape compatible. Completion ERROR call sites covered: `produce_completion_verdict` preflight (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py`) and mid-run recovery (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_failures.py`). Non-completion call sites deliberately not enriched: plan-review preflight/mid-run in `gate_dispatch.py`, code-review preflight/mid-run in `gate_dispatch.py`.

### Scope / file impact

- `src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py`: derive/stamp PASS/FAIL `material_fingerprint`, `material_basis`, and `verifier_version` in the shared builder/emitter; preserve readers' tolerance of absent fields.
- `src/rebar/_commands/completion_bundle.py`: atomic PASS direct `build_payload` caller; verify enriched payload stays compatible with bundle/signing behavior.
- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py`, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/completion-verification.yaml`, `src/rebar/schemas/completion_precheck_output.schema.json`, and `src/rebar/schemas/completion_reconcile_input.schema.json`: thread `completion_prefetch_manifest` onto the verdict without changing context text or verdict decisions.
- `src/rebar/llm/gate_error_sidecar.py`: conditionally stamp only completion ERROR records with best-effort material/version observability fields; preserve error propagation and non-completion shapes.
- `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py`: RED/GREEN tests.

### Verification plan

1. RED first: add the FAIL-sidecar regression test and run only it. It must fail because current `completion_sidecar.emit(... material=None ...)` writes `material_fingerprint: null` and no `verifier_version`.
2. GREEN implementation: enrich records only. New tests assert the pinned FAIL fingerprint changes when `receipt_digest` changes (proving the actual ticket/comment snapshot participates), carries `material_basis="pinned_completion_inputs"`, and includes the prefetch manifest and `verifier_version` object. Additional tests cover PASS direct-builder enrichment, deterministic/unpinned FAIL fallback, completion-only ERROR enrichment, and plan-review/code-review ERROR non-enrichment.
3. AC3 reader proof: exercise `latest_fail_verdict` / `latest_pass_record` on legacy-shaped payloads lacking material/version and assert they still return rather than reject the record.
4. Mutation-teeth: in a sandbox, reintroduce the omission by making the builder ignore verdict material/basis again; the held-out FAIL test must return to RED, then restore the fix.
5. Safety: run focused sidecar, workflow-contract, and atomic-close tests; confirm emitted verdict strings, signability, close blocking, and best-effort swallowing are unchanged.

### Acceptance criteria mapping

- AC1: PASS/FAIL sidecars fingerprint pinned verifier inputs via existing plan material plus completion read-basis receipt digest and prefetch identifiers; deterministic/unpinned FAIL and ERROR records use explicit material_basis fallbacks.
- AC2: `verifier_version` records prompt id, prompt content hash, and formula/gate-code version.
- AC3: no backfill/prune/reader rejection change; old records remain accepted as unknown era.
- AC4: RED→GREEN FAIL sidecar test asserts non-null fingerprint/version and proves the fingerprint depends on the pinned receipt digest.
